ActiveRule.description: One rule as the engine applies it.

assert.description:
The `assert` expression of a `[[tasks.rules]]` or `[[commits.rules]]`
entry.

check.description: The Typst function a `check` rule calls.

message.description:
What a breach prints, when that text is fixed: the rule's `message`,
else for an `assert` rule the engine's `must satisfy` advice. `None`
when each breach words its own: a `check` rule prints what its
function returns, and a body rule with no `message` prints its gate's
text for the heading at fault.

name.description:
The dotted name `mt config show --origin` prints, such as
`tasks.rules.start-title-with-verb` or `tasks.rules[3]` for an unnamed
rule. A flip action takes its hook's, followed by its slot, so it
reads `on.flip.review-stale-task-before-starting.actions[1]`, or
`on.flip[0].actions[1]` for an unnamed hook.

section.description: The array the rule comes from.

severity.description:
The severity a breach reports at: the rule's own, else the level the
engine applies to its section.

when.description: The filter gating which tasks, commits or flips the rule applies to.

CheckSpec.description:
Call a Typst function instead of evaluating an `assert` expression, with
`check = { typst, function, field }`.

field.description:
Field whose value the function receives (`none` when the task omits
it). Absent means the function receives the whole task, in the shape
`mt eval --json` prints.

function.description: Name of the function `typst` exports that this rule calls.

typst.description:
Path to the Typst module exporting `function`, relative to the project
root (the directory holding `.mindtape/`), or to the directory of the
pack that declares the rule.

DerivedField.description: One derived field a project declares, as `mt explain rules` prints it.

detail.description:
A Typst query's module and function, `module::function`, or an
ast-grep query's language, pattern and optional glob, such as
``rust `parse_task($$$ARGS)` ``.

origin.description: The layer or pack that declared the collector.

readers.description: The `[[tasks.rules]]` entries that read the field, by report label.

Severity.description: How a breached config-declared constraint reports.

oneOf.description: Print the breach; the command still succeeds. The default.
Print the breach and fail the command.

description: The object `mt explain rules --json` prints: the active rules and derived fields.

$schema.description: The URL of the schema this object conforms to.

derived.description: The derived fields the config declares.

rules.description: The rules the config applies, in `mt config show --origin` order.

title: Mindtape rules
